scope: QIK-VRT VRTCore Virtual Sphere H6 local exact-byte candidate

runtime_artifacts.compatibility_preload_role: optional local runtime compatibility; when supplied its exact digest is mandatory

cryptographic_assumptions.assumption: Collision and second-preimage resistance are relied on for practical byte identity.

boundaries: The Lean kernel checks terms relative to its implementation, imports and declared logical axioms.
The optional compatibility preload is a local /proc/self/exe workaround and is not a mathematical axiom; normal Lean runtimes execute without it.
The external verifier computes SHA-256 and exact inventories; Lean retains but does not authenticate ExactArtifactBinding strings.
The unavailable VM/container image digest is disclosed rather than invented.
Hardware and operating-system observations are provenance, not proof of physical adequacy.
No foundation-free, implementation-independent or physical truth claim is made.
